title: Stickers to Spell Word
summary: Given n types of stickers, each containing a lowercase English word, determine the minimum number of stickers required to spell out a given target word.
statement: Given n types of stickers, each containing a lowercase English word, determine the minimum number of stickers required to spell out a given target word. You may use each sticker multiple times. If it is impossible to spell the target word using the stickers, return -1.
constraints: 1 <= len(stickers) <= 50; target has at most 15 lowercase letters.
Stickers may be reused; return the minimum count needed to form target or -1.
hints: Only the multiset of still-needed letters matters.
Memoize a canonical sorted remainder and subtract each useful sticker.
Try stickers containing the first remaining letter; recurse on need-sticker and add one.
Canonical remainders merge different application orders, and requiring the first letter prunes equivalent unhelpful choices.
editorial: Canonical remainders merge different application orders, and requiring the first letter prunes equivalent unhelpful choices.

tests.explanation: Three stickers suffice to supply every required letter.
No sticker contains a b, so the target is impossible.
